math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\begin{gathered}y=\left|- x^{2} + 1\right|+2\xrightarrow{\text{向左平移}\,2\,\text{个单位}}y=\left|- \left(x + 2\right)^{2} + 1\right|+2\\(u,v)\longmapsto(u - 2,v)\end{gathered}\\\begin{gathered}y=\left|- \left(x + 2\right)^{2} + 1\right|+2\xrightarrow{\text{向下平移}\,3\,\text{个单位}}y=\left|- \left(x + 2\right)^{2} + 1\right|-1\\(u,v)\longmapsto(u,v - 3)\end{gathered}\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: 分步移动图像

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}\text{A}:\ \text{中间转折点}:\ x=-1,y=0,\ \text{两端向下},\ \text{左右对称}\quad\text{两端方向不符、中间转折点横坐标不符}\\\text{B}:\ \text{中间转折点}:\ x=-2,y=-1,\ \text{两端向下},\ \text{左右对称}\quad\text{两端方向不符、中间转折点纵坐标不符}\\\text{C}:\ \text{中间转折点}:\ x=-2,y=0,\ \text{右折点}:\ x=-1,y=-1,\ \text{两端向上},\ \text{左右对称}\quad\text{已标坐标、对称性和两端方向均符合}\\\text{D}:\ \text{左折点}:\ y=0\quad\text{左折点纵坐标不符}\end{gathered}$$
